newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: NEWPORT DETAILS 29 MLN RAND RIGHTS ISSUE.
newsitem.headline: NEWPORT DETAILS 29 MLN RAND RIGHTS ISSUE.

text.p: Newport Property Fund said on Monday that it will raise 29 million rand, before expenses, through a rights offer of over 7.2-million new units.
It said that 15 new units will be issued for every 100 held on April 18. The issue price of each unit will be 400 cents.

Newport said unitholders holding some 60.7 percent of the company's units have given irrevocable undertakings to exercise their rights. UAL Property Fund Managers has underwritten the balance of the subscriptions.
